mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in CPIAUCSL above 3% over two consecutive quarters signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, which reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3% for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 of more than 2% signals a contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 falls by more than 2% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 5% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressure and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) when UNRATE exceeds 5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in PAYEMS and a fall in UNRATE indicates a broad-based employment expansion without wage inflation, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while UNRATE decreases in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO above 0.5% for four consecutive months signals accelerating industrial production, reflecting economic expansion and higher corporate revenues, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods when INDPRO exceeds 0.5% growth for four consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in FEDFUNDS above 5% within a month signals an aggressive tightening cycle, which raises discount rates and depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS jumps above 5.0% in one month
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) after FEDFUNDS exceeds 5% in a single month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 and HOUST above their respective 12-month moving averages signals improving housing and overall demand, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both exceed 12-month moving average in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.10) when both GDPC1 and HOUST exceed their 12-month moving averages in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in INDPRO below -0.3% for three consecutive months signals a manufacturing slowdown, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, except during periods of coordinated monetary easing.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < -0.3% for three consecutive months and FEDFUNDS not falling in the same period
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO falls below -0.3% for three consecutive months and FEDFUNDS does not decline during the same period.
